title: Sonnet Self-Reflection Howto
desc: How and when to add patterns to the sonnet-reflection skill -- the living harness lesson log
steps: WHEN to add a new pattern: (a) a guard fires 2+ times in different sessions for the same root cause, (b) a Haiku or Codex agent fails silently and forced root-cause diagnosis, (c) a workaround was applied without fixing the real cause -- each of these indicates a harness gap.

HOW to add: run wkappbot skill edit sonnet-reflection --add-step 'PATTERN N name: what happened. Fix: what harness block/guard to add.' Keep the format concrete and action-oriented -- name the guard to add, not generic advice.
RATE-LIMIT: add at most 2 patterns per session. After adding, verify with wkappbot skill read sonnet-reflection.

requirements.expect: WHEN to add a new pattern

author: claude
